01 / Eggs & hatching

A little life, earned.

Eight egg kinds, nine shell stages, and a hatch player you can pause and inspect frame by frame.

From the first crack to an open shell

Five stages while you earn it. Four when you open it.

A turn egg takes 40 counted turns. The green strip under each portrait shows its eight-cell status-line sprite. The light stays plain until the shell bursts and reveals the rarity.

Eight kinds. One small beginning.

Choose an egg, its progress, and a possible rarity. Hatch it, pause it, or drag the frame control to inspect the opening. These are local previews; nothing is added to a real collection.
